reviews.text: I had to put down my dog of 13 years yesterday and although it’s been one of the worst pains I’ve experienced the team made us more comfortable. They allowed us to bring my 15 year old dog for their last goodbye. I just want to thank the whole team for their hospitality and explaining everything to me despite going alone. Everyone there didn’t let me feel alone so thank you. Truly thank you for making my max comfortable in the last few moments w him. I love you maxie❤️

Everyone at Eagle Rock Pet Care are the best!  I had a lot of paperwork to get done for my move to Hawaii… and everyone was so helpful and patient… I hope I can find a Veterinarian Group as good…. Thank you Eagle Rock Pet Care for everything….
Nice place

Dr. Cornelius is knowledgeable, caring, efficient and is everything you want in a doctor! Even though we received difficult news we know our little mamma kitty is receiving the best care and plan for her problems. They call back when they say they will and everyone is friendly. They also have a lot of in-house testing so less wait time for a lot of answers which is very helpful. Highly, highly recommend.

I needed a USDA-accredited vet to file paperwork to move my pet internationally. Before my first appointment, I was assured that the office had experience with international pet travel, but my experience suggested otherwise.

The front desk staff, though polite and friendly, filed all of the paperwork, but appeared to have no experience with the process, resulting in several paperwork and scheduling errors.

Communication was extremely poor, I was never updated unless I called first, despite my stated departure date approaching. Despite my efforts, the manager was unable to speak with me directly until my paperwork was already en route back from the USDA, after I had to postpone my flight and cancel my accommodations last minute (a delay caused largely by an understaffed USDA).

The waiting times seemed unusually long, including on occasions I didn't need an exam room. One of my vet 'visits' consisted of nothing more than checking my dog's heart and asking if everything seemed ok, after which I was left to sit in the exam room for nearly an hour while my dog got progressively more anxious over the commotion in the clinic.

I understand that I am not the only patient requiring attention. However, given the timelines around how long paperwork is valid after being signed, as well as the financial and emotional costs of having this process further disrupted, I wish this matter had been handled with greater urgency and care.

p.s. I'd rather receive no response than an AI generated one.

I was wirh a previous vet for 20+ years but he retired and the care has not been the same and the cost has gone up.  I came to Eagle Rock Pet Care for my two dogs and they exceeded my expectations.  From the moment I walked to the time I left the staff and Dr. Teves explained in detail the cause of my dogs issues.  They did not force and tests and procedures and gave me estimates before agreeing to anything.  Once xrays were done Dr. Teves showed the  readings and compared it to a normal dog so I could get a better understanding.  He thoroughly explained the recommended treatment and medications.   My dogs are so much betrer and I owe it all to the great staff and Dr. Teves.  I just found my new vet.

We needed a vet right away for our tortoise and thanks to the helpful and efficient front desk staff were able to see Dr. Cornelius the same day. He ordered xrays and a lab test that was done there and subsequently we returned with the tortoise twice a week for a month for an antibiotic injection. We appreciated that we were not kept waiting a long time for each visit and the vet techs especially Priscilla (apologies if incorrect name) were caring and genuinely interested in how the tortoise was doing. I noticed the practice offers its own care plan which I will consider if I ever get another pet as we really liked our experiences here.
The staff at Eagle rock pet care are wonderful. Very helpful. You can tell that they really care for the animals. Would recommend. Easy to schedule through the app. Would recommend this place.

I am sharing my experience so other pet owners are aware of what my dog went through at Eagle Rock.

I brought my dog to Eagle Rock with blood work and X-ray results from another veterinary clinic. After reviewing those records, the doctor came in and stated that he already had a diagnosis of pancreatitis and bronchitis. I carefully explained my dog’s symptoms, including daily vomiting, nausea, regurgitation, excessive salivation, weight loss, retching, and pain indicated by groaning when moving or changing positions.

Despite repeatedly explaining that my dog could not tolerate oral medications because she would vomit them back up, she was sent home with multiple medications. I asked several times whether injectable alternatives could be used, as injections seemed to be the only treatment she was tolerating. Instead, I was instructed to continue giving medications that she was unable to keep down, so she got intoxicated.

The doctor also recommended a PCR test that cost nearly $400. Several days later, I was informed that the sample had become contaminated and that the test would need to be repeated or refunded. Given how sick my dog already was, I was very concerned about putting her through the procedure a second time.

As my dog’s condition continued to worsen, I scheduled a follow-up appointment. During that visit, the doctor spent what seemed to be 5 minutes in the room and asked many of the same questions that had already been discussed at the first appointment. At that point, my concern was that my dog was struggling to keep food down at all, while continuing to lose weight, vomit, regurgitate, and show signs of pain.

My dog was visibly ill on the exam table, displaying many of the symptoms I had repeatedly described, yet she was not physically examined or even checked, I told him “look this is what keeps happening” and he distanced himself from the table after a quick glance at her, seemed lost or not worried enough. The doctor then said he needed to leave in the middle of the rushed conversation and would return, but he never came back. I left without receiving answers, a treatment plan, or guidance on next steps. The appointment felt rushed and incomplete, and I left with less confidence that my dog’s condition was being properly addressed.

When I later called the clinic today to discuss my concerns, I felt that the interaction with the front desk was dismissive and unprofessional. While trying to understand what had happened and seek clarification, I did not feel that my concerns were being taken seriously. At one point, I was told, “Dogs don’t talk, so we can’t know what’s going on” by the one and only front desk Diane. While that statement may be true in a literal sense, it was frustrating to hear after spending weeks carefully documenting and communicating my dog’s symptoms in an effort to advocate for her care. She may not speak with words but I DO. And while I’ve been speaking very clearly this whole time, no one listened.

Ultimately, I sought treatment elsewhere. The diagnosis provided by another veterinarian differed significantly from what I was initially told at Eagle Rock. The untreated bronchitis seen on the original X-rays progressed to pneumonia. The inflammation that had been attributed to pancreatitis was later determined to involve her gastrointestinal tract, including her stomach and intestines. In addition, because her condition was not properly managed, she developed secondary megaesophagus, which I can only hope will improve with time.

There was a HUGE lack of thorough evaluation, follow-up, communication, care, and urgency throughout my experience. Had I relied solely on this clinic for my dog’s care, I genuinely believe the outcome could have been much worse.

I am grateful that my dog is still with me today, but based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.
Great doctor there is a lot of hate but the truth is he is great is is just trying to do things by the books. Will definitely continue to come.

I'm angry I can't leave no stars. My 16 y.o. cat refuses to eat for 6 days now. I setup an appt to put her to sleep. They quoted $253.60. Drove an hour in traffic with her howling in fear. 20 minutes later the Dr. comes in and gives me a litany of excuses why he wouldn't/couldn't put her to sleep. 1-Might not actually be my cat and he could be sued. 2-Due to new rules they are required to try to save my cat or they could get in trouble. I asked why didn't the girl who setup the appt tell me this when I told her I want to put my cat to sleep? His answer -  "She's not a doctor" Give me a break. That is the dumbest answer ever. Any front office girl would know to state this detail when making an appt. for euthanasia, if it was actually true. He had other dumb excuses which I blocked because he was mumbling and making it up as he went along. Bottom line: This place is a money scam. They are trying to get me to spend more money. They DO NOT care about your pet unless you spend a LOT of money. He knew my cat is suffering and sent me on my way for another hour in traffic and another day of suffering. Dear Eagle Rock Pet Care - Do not reply that you are sorry for the problem, bla, bla, bla. I do not believe anything you say. I never leave bad reviews, but this visit demanded that I say something. Pasadena Humane Society suggested you. I'm calling them tomorrow. I'm angry.

I can’t say enough good things about this hospital and the entire staff. The last couple of days have been one of the most stressful experiences I’ve ever had with my cat, Milo, and every single person here has been amazing.

After Milo had a urinary blockage and needed a catheter, he kept getting his cone off. I ended up coming back four or five times in one day, and every single time I walked through the doors, everyone was so patient, kind, and understanding. Not once did anyone make me feel like I was bothering them. They just kept helping us with a smile and so much compassion.

A huge thank you to Stephanie and Angelina at the front desk. They were always welcoming, caring, and reassuring every time I came in.

A very special thank you to Paloma, the technician. She has the patience of a saint. I honestly don’t know how she did it, but she stayed calm, gentle, and compassionate every single time we came back. She took such great care of Milo and never made me feel embarrassed or judged, even after seeing us over and over again.

And thank you to Dr. Tevez. He took the time to explain everything, answered every question I had, and made sure I understood exactly what was going on with Milo. You can tell he truly cares about his patients and the families who love them.

The entire team went above and beyond for us. They weren’t just taking care of my cat they were helping me through one of the most emotional and stressful experiences I’ve had as a pet owner. That kindness meant more than they’ll probably ever know.

Thank you all so much for taking such wonderful care of Milo. I will always be grateful for everything you did, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares.

I can’t thank Paloma enough for the amazing care they gave my cat. From the moment we walked in, everyone was kind, compassionate, and professional. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and treated my cat with so much patience and genuine care.

I truly felt that my pet was in the best hands. The staff went above and beyond during a stressful time, and I’m so grateful for their dedication and kindness. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone looking for a team that truly cares about both their patients and their families. Thank you again for everything you do!

This place is awful. They changed management and made me waste 74 dollars for an appointment to do absolutely no exam on my dog and claim that all of a sudden they can’t give me a refill on her meds with out 500 dollars worth of blood work. They could have told me this over the phone. The vet kept trying to explain to me all these useless examples of why he needed to do the work before prescribing and claim it’s because my dog is old now. Last year they gave me the same anxiety meds for her for Fourth of July. Sounds like bs take your pet somewhere else.

The staff here has always been polite, but I’ve decided to move my dog’s care elsewhere.

My issue isn’t that veterinary care is expensive. It’s that almost every interaction felt like another fee, another charge, another step. Over time, it started to feel more like nickel-and-diming than problem-solving.

A recent example: my French bulldog needed his anal glands expressed. As an existing patient, I was quoted separate charges that felt excessive for a routine procedure. Meanwhile, I recently visited another veterinary hospital as a brand-new client. They required an initial exam, which is completely reasonable, but afterward the procedure is simply a flat fee whenever it’s needed.

The difference was the overall experience. The new clinic was clean, efficient, transparent, and had me in and out quickly.

Others may feel differently, but for me, Eagle Rock Pet Care became too expensive and too transactional. I think pet owners deserve straightforward pricing and a focus on care first.

If I could give this place negative stars I would this plae is the worst place you could take your animal avoid at all cost incorrectly diagnosed my cat with diabetes paid 1106$ at the vet the first time for multiple shots and X-rays for them to tell me oh the xray came out blurry we should send it to a specialist (well then why am I still paying g for the xray if it came out blurry) then the blood test came back and he said our machine is acting funny so you should send it out to a specialist also (well why am I paying g for the blood test then if your machine dosent work properly) this place is just a price gouge .   Then they say oh your cat has diabetes so I pay another 160$ for the insulin which is expensive .  I then give him the shot for a couple days the tell me to make another appt for a couple days later so I come back today and they take the xray and shots again and say oh it's just gonna be a 25$ recheck fee to see what's wrong with my cat because he's still not eating so they check and he dosent have diabetes!!!! He has only eaten string and the dr. Says on he won't pass that at all not by himself  so he says he needs a surgery as soon as possible so quotes me 4k for a surgery for a surgery!!! And charges me 600$ the same day for the xray and the blood test which he said will only be 25$ for rechecking !!! And what happens the next day my cat poops out the string by himself he was trying to get me to come in asap before my cat pooped out the string so he got me to pay the 4k !!! This place is a scam !!!!
Great Doctor. My cat Whitey went in for her yearly check up. Technician was excellent, and their service was outstanding. I’ll be again next year.

Hello Bryan,

Thank you for your 5-star rating and support. We’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet and appreciate you choosing our team. We look forward to seeing you again.

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

Hello Mary,

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We’re grateful for your support and are glad you chose us to care for your pet. If there is anything we can do to make your next visit even better, we’d love to hear your feedback. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again.

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

Had a great experience here with Dr. Cornelius for my pet Rooster. He was very knowledgeable and gentle, as well as thorough. Sure, it took a while at the office, but I'm happy they looked into all alternatives instead of just euthanasia and rushing through the appointment. I feel more confident in making the decision now to ease my Chico's pain. Cost was average. I've been to more expensive places.

I normally do not leave reviews this long, but after everything I have personally experienced, witnessed, and continued hearing over the years regarding Eagle Rock Pet Care, I genuinely feel people should be cautious before trusting this place with their animals.

I went there myself once and never returned. The wait was extremely long despite arriving on time, and by the time I was finally seen, the entire interaction felt rushed and disorganized. Instead of leaving with clarity or reassurance, I left feeling confused about what was actually being recommended, why certain things were being pushed, and whether anyone was truly taking the time to look at the overall situation carefully.

What disturbed me even more afterward was realizing how many other people describe the exact same experiences. One of the biggest recurring complaints I keep seeing in reviews and hearing locally involves pets being pushed into additional tests, procedures, treatments, or vaccine schedules that owners felt were unrelated to the original reason for the visit. The issue is not simply that services were offered, it is that many people describe leaving without a clear understanding of why those recommendations were medically necessary in the first place. Which tends to be a pattern that shows up repeatedly.

This is not just something I noticed online either. In my own apartment building, several pet owners actively avoid this clinic despite it being within walking distance because of negative experiences and concerns shared over time. That says a lot considering how convenient the location is for us.

One situation that especially stayed with me involved a neighbor’s dog in the building. I personally saw that dog about two days before what was supposed to be a quick  routine appointment here, and the dog appeared completely healthy, energetic, and normal. Shortly after the visit with Dr. Cornelius, the dog passed away. The timing shocked a lot of people in the building because there had been no obvious signs anything was seriously wrong beforehand. It became a serious topic of concern among neighbors regarding what happened during that appointment and how everything afterward was handled and communicated.

At a certain point, when the same concerns keep appearing from completely different people over and over again, people are going to start paying attention.

Please do your research carefully before bringing your pet here!

Hi,

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate the feedback and are here if you need anything else for your fur-baby.

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

While the front desk staff and vet tech were nice, Dr. Teves had absolutely no bedside manner. I brought my dog in for a cough. In the room, he made comments about social media, court and liability. On top of that, he used the phrase "kill your dog" at least 4 times while he was in the room. I left in tears.

It es soo comforting to meet a doctor who's nonverbal communication was kindness and concern. These are not just pets it our family. from the intake desk to exist was above average Thank You I will also be bringing my 2 dogs

Just adopted a 6 week kitten and was able to set appointment and got seen same day. All the staff were amazing and gave clear guidance on how to care for our new family member. Shout out to Mike and Dr. Padilla!

DON’T bring your reptiles here. Staff may have a degree in vet care but is absolutely NOT knowledgeable about reptiles. He has general knowledge of them, but reptile care variates from species to species in major ways. He assumes same or similar care for reptiles. I brought my chameleon to have an access removed. Upon walking in the room he immediately expressed (popped) the abscess without consulting with me, and to make things worse he didn’t even flush with saline or other antiseptic. He goes out the room to consult his vet software on what to do cause clearly he has no idea. He claims he wants to save me money and says the next step is a $400 culture to see what bacteria is in there. Most exotic vets would move differently especially for an abscess in early stage on the animal’s foot. They would normally remove/scrape the abscess core properly, express all the puss out, and FLUSH wound properly. First of all he popped the abscess without scraping, flushing, or pulling the abscess core out successfully. Within hours my chameleon’s foot looked the same as it was before, only difference is I had to drop $110 to hear things I already knew and see the horror unfold in front of me. I tried being trusting and respectful, but honestly this place is just sad. Don’t give yourself a headache and check other vets with reviews. I came here looking for an economical solution when I should have spent a bit more or researched more places. Reptile care is expensive but that’s not what I’m upset about, what I’m upset about is mainly him expressing the abscess without warning and him going straight to culture when I cannot afford that, I wish he would have helped me keep costs down and given me empirical antibiotics first. Not everyone can afford the extensive methods and I don’t think reptile keepers should be taken advantage of like this. I understand what culturing does, but going straight to that without first trying empirical treatment is insane.
I had a pleasant experience here.  The prices are comparable to the other Vet hospitals.    They were quick, friendly and knowledgeable.     Thanks again.

I had a great experience at Eagle Rock Pet Care.

I took my 2 year old pit bull, Cash, for a check up and from the moment I walked in, every staff member I interacted with was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and genuinely caring. It made what could have been a stressful visit feel easy and comfortable.

Dr. Padillia was absolutely wonderful—so patient, attentive, and compassionate. You can tell they truly care about the animals they treat, taking the time to explain everything clearly and making sure all my concerns were addressed without ever feeling rushed.

A special thank you as well to Angelena at the front desk, who was extremely helpful and kind with Cash. She made the check-in and follow-up process smooth and stress-free, and her positive attitude really stood out.

Overall, the level of care and customer service here is outstanding. I can’t recommend them enough.
There services are great and fast will go again with my future bets also great prices

We scheduled an appointment for our cat to get neutered a few weeks ago.

Upon scheduling, they only asked for an EKG to be done prior.

Fast forward to the day before the appointment and they want us to come in last minute to get bloodwork done.

They want $277 for the bloodwork on top of the $400-$700 for the neutering work that had to be done.

Now, the money isn't the issue personally, however, it would have been great to know about the bloodwork being needed when scheduling this so we can set up an appropriate budget.

This felt predatory and will NOT be using this place. We now have to find a different place to get our cat neutered last minute.
I  called & was able to set up an appointment right away and even got 50% off my first-time patient consultation. The staff were really nice and awesome, and Dr. Padilla was super chill and sweet!
They really do care for your pet. They are efficient, and friendly, clean and most importantly, answer the phones in person.

Been looking after my first ever pet (cat) and they've been so great with her. Very easy to schedule appointments and the costs are reasonable. Such a great staff! Happy that I've found a place that offers such wonderful care so close to me ❤️

Hi Olympia,

Thank you for your rating! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support our team and care for your pet.

We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

Since the transition to a different ownership/name of this vet, I have not been pleased with the quality of service given and cleanliness of the place . I took my dog as he was limping in his front paw.  Vet Doc recommended us to get X-rays and some blood work done. We were fine with that. However x-rays and bloodwork results took 3 days to get results back. Results were given over the phone rather than shown through the x-ray. Nor were we given x-ray afterwards. Also medication took 2 days to pick up. Was not please how all of this could’ve been done the same day. We have been coming here for years, now we found a better place at next to panda express in eagle rock. The new place I go to now gives results same day and explained throughly also very organized. Hope this place can get it together when it was known as “affordable animal hospital”.

For over 10 years I've been coming here. As soon as there was new owners their services got worse and worse. Constant miscommunication. When I got blood work the vet used to go into details about the result now they just say it's good and that's it over an email. Do not come here.

Hello Eric, thank you so much for taking the time to offer your feedback. It is appreciated and we hope Stacy is doing well. We look forward to seeing her for her follow up appointment.

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

The service was excellent. Dr and staff were extremely helpful. My only complaint is that they did X-rays on my cats face. Her eyes is swollen shut and doesn’t appear to be an infection or a cut in her eye so possibly broken bones. They said the results would take 2 weeks to get. 2 weeks???? That’s ridiculous and I don’t understand the delay. Other than that I thought the scheduling, staff and Dr were great and I would recommend
They took good care of my dog. My dog Max was in good hands. God bless eagle Rock pet care 🙂
Vets were very reassuring about my dogs well being and answered all my questions with helpful advise about his at home care.

Eleanor, thank you for your review! We’re glad you had a positive experience with us. We appreciate your support and hope to see you again.

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

I can't figure out how to reply to a comment on here so i'll just add-- the review wasn't really because of the timeliness issue.  Although you guys are closed more days of the week than you are open, and really hard to get a hold of.

What really sealed the one star for me was when I took my cat for a routine checkup here. The vet wanted to get a urine sample from her but refused to do it during the appointment; they sent me home to collect my cat's urine with some vague instructions.  I'm not a medical professional so obviously i got cat piss all over the place. Maybe it was the doctor's sick idea of a joke. When I brought the sample in they told me it wasn't enough and to try it again. I decided to find a different vet that wouldn't ask me to do their work for them.

Los feliz animal hospital has been awesome so far.

Hi Allyson, it was a pleasure meeting you and Zeek! Thank you for your feedback, it really means a lot to us. We look forward to seeing you both for Zeek's follow up appointment. 

The Eagle Rock Pet Care Team

I took my dog here a few days ago. The main vet gave a bunch of information that was not part of the reason we came in. He said he would give me a prescription for a special  type of food and forgot. He also forgot that he said he was going to give my dog a blood test. The clinic was empty at the time just me and one other pet owner. Don’t know why he was so forgetful. I decided not to return.

Don’t go here. I could say so many reasons why but this sums it up well…vet told me to get my kitten neutered and microchipped at the same time because of pain…when they neutered him they forgot to microchip him.

Everytime we went they forgot something, we got over charged (check your invoice they double charged us a couple times) or it took hours.

Over $1,500 to get his basic vaccines and neutering (and microchipping which we didn’t get). One time they took so long (over 3 hours) that my kitten peed himself waiting, this was his first vet trip not a great start. We had an appointment booked not a drop in.

Don’t bother with this place. There’s another vet 300ft down the road. Gonna try there. Maybe they will remember to microchip my cat. Upset because it’s going to hurt him now.

Hi, James. I am sorry to see that your experience was not a positive one. We would love to speak to you further. Please give us a call at your convenience, we would love to hear from you.
The Eagle Rock Pet Team

The professionals here have provided such great care for my two cats! The staff are always welcoming, kind, and thorough in their explanations. They also make sure to send reminders for appointments and upcoming care for which your pets are due. The veterinarians truly care about providing the best medical support they can for your pets; they take the time to get to know their patients (and the patients’ humans), and tailor their recommendations accordingly.

The facilities are very clean. Even when there’s a wait, the staff do their best to keep everyone updated.
The service is friendly and the doctor is very professional.

This place used to be fine; theyd neglect to write my cats’ weight down on any paperwork but it was otherwise solid. I hadnt been back in a couple years when i returned today. First, the vet tech said “it’s hard to count her breaths” while doing the respiration assessment (bc my cat has long hair) which is troubling because breathing is a specific issue i said ive had concern with and it did not seem like she was confident in her assessment. Dr cornelius (?) made no effort to ameliorate himself to my nervous cat, and was visibly and verbally annoyed with her squirming a little while he forced open her mouth to look at her gums. Next, the vet techs were unable to do any of the tests on my cat because my she “got feisty” (i was not present but i believe she would not like getting tests—is this not common?), and they said i needed to purchase a sedative and return another time. Maybe this is normal but my cat is not like an especially antisocial cat so it surprised me. I do not care about professionalism for the sake of it but i witnessed a disorganized front desk of people arguing with each other trying to figure out the vaccine schedule for another guy and his dog; and, after id paid i told the vet tech i was just waiting for my cat still, and she straight up said “oh i kinda forgot about her back there”, which, fine, but insane to tell me to my face about someone obviously very important to me? I dont write reviews really but the vibes were very bad and i hope they do something about it. I will be trying a new vet for the remaining tests and treatment my cat needs.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE! I was looking for an affordable vet to have my kittens spayed and neutered. I called this clinic,
explained that my kittens were about 10 weeks old, and specifically asked if they could perform
the procedure at their age. I was told yes, so I scheduled a consultation.
On the day of the appointment, I brought both kittens with my sister. The waiting room was
empty, and we were seen right away. The staff weighed the kittens, did a wellness exam, and
asked if we had questions. We explained we wanted them spayed/neutered, microchipped, and
asked about flea treatment. A nurse mentioned specials for kittens, and when the vet came in,
she told us they’d need bloodwork before surgery and that chipping would be done at the same
time to avoid extra pain. She also gave us advice about fleas and diet. Everything sounded fine,
so we agreed to the bloodwork.
When we checked out, the visit cost around $600, including about $180 per kitten for
bloodwork. At the front desk, things went downhill. The three people at the desk didn’t know
how much the procedure itself cost, and even after calling a manager, no one seemed sure. At
one point, my sister and I weren’t even sure if we were supposed to be standing there because
no one acknowledged us. Eventually, they figured out a total (after I reminded them I’d already
paid for bloodwork) and scheduled the surgery for the following Wednesday. They wanted me to make a down payment for the surgeries but I was already put off by them so I didn’t, thank goodness.
A few days later, I got a voicemail from Michael at the clinic, saying the vet usually waits until
kittens are six months old to perform spay/neuter. I was furious—why did they schedule me, put
my kittens through bloodwork, and take my money if they knew this? Worse, by the time my
kittens turned six months, the bloodwork would need to be repeated, meaning I’d have to pay
for it all over again.
I called back and spoke to a woman who repeated the same explanation: “the doctor waits until
six months.
” I told her that I had called ahead before scheduling and was told it was fine. I also
told her that I would go to the clinic and demand my money back. But after talking it over with
my sister, we decided to let it go, because it would probably be a lost cause and they likely
wouldn’t refund me anyway. Later that same day, I got another voicemail, this time from Norma,
saying they’d spoken to the doctor and manager and would go ahead with the procedure after
all. By that point, I had completely lost trust.
Between the incompetence of the front desk staff, the confusion over prices, the
unnecessary bloodwork, and the lack of clear protocols, I would never allow them near my
kittens again. I don’t know how their other services are, but from what I experienced, this clinic is
disorganized, misleading, and more focused on money than proper care. I strongly advise you go somewhere else.
Their google, window front, and website hours are inaccurate. I came on a Friday at 9am (within their posted vet hours) and no one was there. A few of us were there, very confused.
Great experience! Friendly staff!

AWESOME SERVICE at Affordable Animal Hospital Eagle Rock, They R O C K!!  Very attentive Staff  towards .my kitty, they definitely worked with my Financial Situation and guided me as to the next steps will be to take care of my kitty, will definitely be back and Highly Recommend this place Special Shout-out to Ms.Fove  as she Treated me with nothing but Kindness, and The Sweet Receptionist  Both make the place Run for sure.

EDIT: I did just receive a very friendly phone call from corporate apologizing for everything and letting me know that they are under new management since my last visit. I still will be seeking services elsewhere but appreciated the call. They have different hours in June that i guess they informed people of by email (I just checked my emails from them, of which i have many, and none of them is about new June hours). Doesn’t match google maps or the posted hours on the door, either, but good for others to know.

Closed during open hours today! (10:45 AM on a Friday, with a sign saying they’ll return at 2:30). Not my first bad experience here unfortunately.
